# Import CRM templates from a csv document

```python Python
import requests
import csv


SUBDOMAIN = ''

API_KEY = ''


CREATE_TEMPLATE_URL = f'https://{SUBDOMAIN}.kommo.com/api/v4/chats/templates'

with open('templates.csv') as csvData:
        templates = csv.DictReader(csvData)

        for template in templates:
                name = template['name']
                body = {
                    'name' : name,
                    "content": template['content'],
                }

                headers = {
                    'Authorization' : f'Bearer {API_KEY}',
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                }

                response = requests.post(CREATE_TEMPLATE_URL, json=body, headers=headers)
                print(response.text)
```

```javascript JavaScript
const fs = require('fs');
const csv = require('csv-parser');
const axios = require('axios');

const subdomain = '';
const apiKey = '';
const baseTemplateUrl = `https://${subdomain}.kommo.com/api/v4/chats/templates`;

const createChatTemplates = async () => {
  const templates = [];

  fs.createReadStream('templates.csv')
    .pipe(csv())
    .on('data', (data) => templates.push(data))
    .on('end', async () => {
      for (const template of templates) {
        try {
          const response = await axios.post(baseTemplateUrl, {
            name: template.name,
            content: template.content
          }, {
            headers: {
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
          });
          console.log(JSON.stringify(response.data, null, 2));
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Error creating template ${template.name}:`, error.response ? error.response.data : error.message);
        }
      }
    });
}

createChatTemplates();
```

# Lead with Tag

```python Python
import requests

SUBDOMAIN = ''
API_KEY = ''

BASE_LEAD_URL = f"https://{SUBDOMAIN}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads"

headers = {
    "accept": "application/json",
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"
}

body = [{
    'name': "Example lead 1",
    '_embedded': {
        "tags": [
            {
                "name": 'NewTag'
            }
        ]
    }
}]

response = requests.post(BASE_LEAD_URL, json=body, headers=headers)

newLeadResponse = response.json()
print(newLeadResponse)

newLead = newLeadResponse["_embedded"]["leads"][0]
leadId = newLead["id"]


# get Lead with tags
newLead = requests.get(f'{BASE_LEAD_URL}/{leadId}', headers=headers).json()
existingTags = newLead['_embedded']["tags"]

newTags = []

for tag in existingTags:
    newTags.append({"id" : tag["id"]})

newTags.append({
    "name": 'NewTag2'
})

body = {
    'id': leadId,
    '_embedded': {
        "tags": newTags
    }
}

response = requests.patch(f'{BASE_LEAD_URL}/{leadId}', json=body, headers=headers)
updateLeadResponse = response.json()
print(updateLeadResponse)
```

```javascript JavaScript
const axios = require('axios');

const subdomain = ''; 
const apiKey = ''; 
const baseLeadUrl = `https://${subdomain}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads`;

  const headers = {
    'accept': 'application/json',
    'content-type': 'application/json',
    'authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`
  };

const createLeadAndUpdateTag = async () => {
  try {
    const body = [{
      'name': 'Example lead 1',
      '_embedded': {
        'tags': [
          {
            'name': 'NewTag'
          }
        ]
      }
    }];

    const newLeadResponse = await axios.post(baseLeadUrl, body, { headers });
    const newLead = newLeadResponse.data._embedded.leads[0];
    const leadId = newLead.id;

    const leadResponse = await axios.get(`${baseLeadUrl}/${leadId}`, { headers });
    const existingTags = leadResponse.data._embedded.tags;

    const newTags = existingTags.map(tag => ({ id: tag.id }));
    newTags.push({ name: 'NewTag2' });

    const leadUpdateData = {
      'id': leadId,
      '_embedded': {
        "tags": newTags
      }
    };

    const updateLeadResponse = await axios.patch(`${baseLeadUrl}/${leadId}`, leadUpdateData, { headers });

    console.log(newLead, updateLeadResponse.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error:', error.response ? error.response.data : error.message);
  }
}

createLeadAndUpdateTag();
```

# Move a lead to another stage

```python Python
import requests

SUBDOMAIN = ''
API_KEY = ''

BASE_LEAD_URL = f"https://{SUBDOMAIN}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads"
BASE_PIPELINE_URL = f"https://{SUBDOMAIN}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads/pipelines"

headers = {
    "accept": "application/json",
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"
}

response = requests.get(BASE_PIPELINE_URL, headers=headers)
pipelinesResponse = response.json()

lastPipeline = pipelinesResponse["_embedded"]["pipelines"][-1]
secondStage = lastPipeline["_embedded"]["statuses"][1]

body = [{
    'name': "Example lead 1",
    'pipeline_id' : lastPipeline["id"],
    'status_id' : secondStage["id"]
}]

response = requests.post(BASE_LEAD_URL, json=body, headers=headers)
newLeadResponse = response.json()
newLead = newLeadResponse["_embedded"]["leads"][0]


leadId = newLead['id']
stageWon = '142'

body = {
    'pipeline_id' : lastPipeline["id"],
    'status_id' : stageWon
}

newLeadResponse = requests.patch(f'{BASE_LEAD_URL}/{leadId}', json=body, headers=headers)
print(newLeadResponse)
updateLeadResponse = response.json()


```

```javascript JavaScript
const axios = require('axios');

const subdomain = '';
const apiKey = '';
const baseLeadUrl = `https://${subdomain}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads`;
const basePipelineUrl = `https://${subdomain}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads/pipelines`;

const headers = {
    'accept': '/json',
    'content-type': 'application/json',
    'authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`
  };

const createLeadAndMoveStage = async () => {
  try {
   const pipelinesResponse = await axios.get(basePipelineUrl, { headers });
   const pipelines = pipelinesResponse.data._embedded.pipelines;
   const lastPipeline = pipelines[pipelines.length - 1];

   const statuses = lastPipeline._embedded.statuses;
   const secondStage = statuses[1];

   const body = [{ 
      name: 'Example lead 1',
      pipeline_id: lastPipeline.id,
      status_id: secondStage.id
    }];

   const leadResponse = await axios.post(baseLeadUrl, body, { headers });
   const newLead = leadResponse.data._embedded.leads[0];
   const leadId = newLead.id;

   const finalStage = statuses[statuses.length - 1]; 
   const leadUpdateData = {
      pipeline_id: lastPipeline.id,
      status_id: finalStage.id  
    };

  const newLeadResponse = await axios.patch(`${baseLeadUrl}/${leadId}`, leadUpdateData, { headers });

  console.log(JSON.stringify(newLeadResponse.data, null, 2));
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Error:', error.response ? error.response.data : error.message);
}
}

createLeadAndMoveStage();
```

# Upload a file by chunks

Source: https://developers.kommo.com/recipes/upload-a-part-of-the-file.md

> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.kommo.com/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# Upload a file by chunks

```javascript JavaScript
const fs = require('fs');
const axios = require('axios');
const path = require('path');

const token = '';
const subdomain = '';
const maxPartSize = 524288;

const baseUri = `https://${subdomain}.kommo.com/api/v4/account?with=drive_url`;

const createSession = async (fileName, fileSize) => {
  try {
    const headers = {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    };

    // get drive_url via API request
    const driveResponse = await axios.get(baseUri, { headers });
    const driveUri = driveResponse.data.drive_url;
    const url = `${driveUri}/v1.0/sessions`;

    const response = await axios.post(
      url,
      {
        file_name: fileName,
        file_size: fileSize,
        content_type: 'image/jpeg',
      },
      { headers }
    );

    return response.data.upload_url;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Create session error:', error.response?.data || error.message);
  }
};

const uploadChunk = async (uploadUri, chunk) => {
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(uploadUri, chunk, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'image/jpeg',
      },
    });

    return response.data.next_url;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Chunk upload error:', error.response?.data || error.message);
  }
};

const uploadFileInParts = async (filePath) => {
  const fileName = path.basename(filePath);
  const fileSize = fs.statSync(filePath).size;
  const file = fs.openSync(filePath, 'r');
  
  let bytesRead = 0;
  let uploadUri = await createSession(fileName, fileSize);

  while (bytesRead < fileSize) {
    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(Math.min(maxPartSize, fileSize - bytesRead));
    fs.readSync(file, buffer, 0, buffer.length, bytesRead);
    bytesRead += buffer.length;

    uploadUri = await uploadChunk(uploadUri, buffer);
  }
  
  console.log('File was uploaded succesfully')

  fs.closeSync(file);
};

// Example of usage (specify the path to the file)
uploadFileInParts('').catch(console.error);
```

# Create session for uploading

<!-- javascript@11-38 -->

This step obtains your account `drive_url`, creates an uploading session and then sends a POST request with the file metadata (name, size and type) to create the session. The URL for further file upload is returned.

# Upload a chunk of the file

<!-- javascript@40-54 -->

This step uploads a part of the file to the server, sending it via a POST request to the specified `uploadUri`.

The URL for the next part to upload will be returned if needed.

# Upload the file by parts

<!-- javascript@56-75 -->

This step performs a file upload by parts: it reads the file from the disk in chunks, uploads each part via the previously obtained `uploadUri`, and updates the link for the next upload until the entire file is uploaded. Upon completion, it displays a message about the successful upload.

# Working with a Lead

```python Python
import requests


SUBDOMAIN = ''
API_KEY = ''


LEAD_BASE_URL = f'{SUBDOMAIN}.kommo.com/api/v4/leads'

body = [{
        "name": "New lead",
        "price": 999,
        "status_id": 1342932,
        "pipeline_id": 7762837,
        "created_by": 10618939,
        "created_at": 1710229627,
        "responsible_user_id": 10618939,
        "custom_fields_values": [
            {
                "field_id": 184994,
                "values": [{ "value": True }]
            }
        ]
}]

headers = {
    'Authorization' : f'Bearer {API_KEY}',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.post(LEAD_BASE_URL, json=body, headers=headers)
newLead = response.json()['_embedded']['leads'][0]

# Get Lead responsilbe user from Account's users
responsibleUserId = ''

GET_USERS_URL = f'https://{SUBDOMAIN}.kommo.com/api/v4/users'
usersResponse = requests.get(GET_USERS_URL, headers=headers).json()
users = usersResponse["_embedded"]["users"]
lastUser = users[-1]
userId = lastUser['id']
responsibleUserId = userId


updateLeadBody = {
    'responsible_user_id': responsibleUserId
}
leadId = newLead['id']
UPDATE_LEAD_URL = f'{LEAD_BASE_URL}/{leadId}'
response = requests.patch(UPDATE_LEAD_URL, json=updateLeadBody, headers=headers)
updatedLead = response.json()
```

```javascript JavaScript
const axios = require('axios');

const subdomain = ''; 
const apiKey = '';    

const baseUrl = `https://${subdomain}.kommo.com/api/v4`;
const leadBaseUrl = `${baseUrl}/leads`;

const headers = {
  'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

const createAndUpdateLead = async () => {
  try {
    const leadBody = [{
      name: 'New lead',
      price: 999,
      status_id: 1342932,
      pipeline_id: 7762837,
      created_by: 10618939,
      created_at: 1710229627,
      responsible_user_id: 10618939,
      custom_fields_values: [
        {
          field_id: 184994,
          values: [{ 'value': True }]
        }
      ]
    }];
    
    const newLeadResponse = await axios.post(leadBaseUrl, leadBody, { headers });
    const newLead = newLeadResponse.data;
    
    const usersResponse = await axios.get(`${baseUrl}/users`, { headers });
    const users = usersResponse.data._embedded.users;
    const responsibleUserId = users[users.length - 1].id;
    
    const leadId = newLead._embedded.leads[0].id;
    const leadUpdateData = {
      responsible_user_id: responsibleUserId
    };
    
    await axios.patch(
      `${leadBaseUrl}/${leadId}`,
      leadUpdateData,
      { headers }
    );
    
    console.log(JSON.stringify(newLead))
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error:', error.response?.data || error.message);
    throw error;
  }
};
```
